name: @egeria-systems/scaffold
description: Builds versioned materialized Next.js recipes for Egeria Systems projects.

scripts.lint:builder: pnpm --filter @egeria-systems/cli --filter @egeria-systems/builder-core --filter @egeria-systems/standards --filter @egeria-systems/observability run lint && pnpm run check:copy-externalization
scripts.test: pnpm run test:constitution && pnpm --filter @egeria-systems/nextjs-cloudflare-proof test:unit && pnpm run test:package-boundaries && pnpm run test:builder-core && pnpm run test:cli && pnpm run test:packages
scripts.test:cli: pnpm --filter @egeria-systems/cli run build && pnpm --filter @egeria-systems/cli run test
scripts.test:generated-project: pnpm --filter @egeria-systems/builder-core run build && pnpm --filter @egeria-systems/builder-core run test:generated-project
scripts.verify:builder-kernel: pnpm run test:constitution && pnpm run test:package-boundaries && pnpm run build:builder && pnpm run test:builder-core && pnpm run test:cli && pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:capability-certification && pnpm run check:capability-certification && pnpm run test:generated-fixtures && pnpm run lint:builder && pnpm run typecheck:builder && pnpm run verify:generated-skeletons && pnpm run changeset:status
scripts.verify:builder-packages:quality: pnpm run test:constitution && pnpm run test:package-boundaries && pnpm run build:builder && pnpm run lint:builder && pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run typecheck:builder
scripts.verify:builder-packages: pnpm run test:constitution && pnpm run test:package-boundaries && pnpm run build:builder && pnpm run lint:builder && pnpm run test:cli && pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run typecheck:builder && pnpm run changeset:status
scripts.verify:booking-calendly-certification: pnpm run build:builder && pnpm --filter @egeria-systems/cli run test && node scripts/certify-booking-calendly.mjs
scripts.verify:package-release-candidate: pnpm run verify:builder-packages:quality && pnpm run check:package-release local
